senses.gloss: f. (רָבַב = b. h. תַּרְבִּית) [profit,] interest on a loan, usury.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 61b">B. Kam. 61ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01836"><he>קָצַץ</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="A00188"><he>אָבָק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 4:3">Tosef. ib. IV, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00726"><he>הַעֲרָמָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:17">Ex. R. s. 31</cite>, a. fr. <he>מלוה</he> (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00206"><he>לָוָה</he></cite>. Tosef. l. c. <he>יש דברים שהן ר׳ ואינן ר׳</he> there are such transactions as have the appearance of usury, but are not usury (are not forbidden).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63a:11">B. Mets. 63ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>צד אחד בר׳</he> one-sided (eventual) usury, a transaction which may eventually result in paying interest on a loan, e.g. advanced payment for fruit to be delivered at some future time at present prices with the option, in case of a rise in the market, of returning the money and paying the difference, in which latter case it looks like paying interest on a loan; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רִבִּיּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="T00053"><he>רִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 6:17">Tosef. B. Mets. VI, 17</cite> <he>מלוי ר׳ כופרין וכ׳</he> those who lend on interest deny the essence &c. (v. <cite ref="P00666"><he>עִיקָּר</he></cite>); (Y. ib. V, end, 10ᵈ <he>מלוה ברבית</he>). Tosef. l. c. 18.
